items.title: Quantum 0-infinity law: divergence of the series of ratios is equivalent to totality of the random orthonormal sequence (Theorem 2.1)
items.author: Bauer, Michel
items.difficulty_reason: 311-319和373-395以Grassmannian条件期望得到残余投影的乘积公式；发散支以dense union和乘积极限得全性，收敛支选择新正交方向并分割有限维complement事件，令残余期望趋1强迫其概率0。完整九步作者链只计该主定理，八个投影/可测/递推支撑不另拆计。

contexts.label: author definitions (source lines 94-97): the increasing integer sequence n with lim n_k = infinity, an n-Matryoshka F (increasing subspace sequence with dim F_k = n_k) and the notion of total (union dense in the Hilbert space)

author prose (source lines 99-102): the trial-space reading of F_k, the increasing sequence m with m_k <= n_k and lim infinity, the notion of an m-Matryoshka E in F with E_k subset of F_k, and the notation E_k^perpF for the orthogonal complement of E_k in F_k

author prose (source lines 105-107): the set M of m-Matryoshkas in F and the unique unitary-invariant probability measure mu_F^m on the Grassmannian of m-dimensional subspaces of a finite-dimensional F (footnoted convention retained)

author definition of the probability measure P on M (source lines 112-120): recursive unitary-invariant choice of E_{k+1} in F_{k+1} containing E_k as E_k direct-sum a (delta m)_k-subspace of E_k^perpF chosen with mu, the Kolmogorov-consistency remark, and the complete filtered probability space (M, algE, (algE_k), P) with algE the sigma-algebra generated by the random subspaces

author prose (source line 127) posing the basic totality question and defining the closure notation: the closure E-bar of the union of the E_k, whose orthogonal complement is the object the theorem controls; delivered so the statement's E-bar^perp is defined

author setup (source lines 181-188): for fixed Matryoshka E and vector v, the orthogonal projections U_k(v) on E_k, W_k(v) = v - U_k(v) on the orthogonal complement of E_k, V_k(v) = U_k(v) - U_{k-1}(v) on the orthogonal complement of E_{k-1} in E_k, and the three-term orthogonal decomposition displays v = U_{k-1} + V_k + W_k and H = E_{k-1} + (E_{k-1}^perp cap E_k) + E_k^perp

author Lemma environment lem:basicfacts1 (printed 4.2, sibling card of this batch): measurability of U_k, V_k, W_k and the a.s.-to-zero characterization via the limit of the expected squared norms; delivered after the statement so the card keeps its printed number (locally renumbered)

author Corollary environment cor:prodineq (printed 4.5, sibling card of this batch): the product formula E(norm W_k(v)^2) = E(norm W_{i-1}(v)^2) prod (1-r_j) with the norm bound and the equality case; the corollary the delivered proofs invoke via its label (locally renumbered)
